policy.visibility: A convention must be visible as itself; never hide a letter, digit or other symbol inside a strict image reading.
policy.strictness: These entries belong to general rebus mode unless a future contract explicitly promotes a convention.
policy.pronunciation: The reading stored here is the name/read-out of the visible symbol, not an arbitrary phoneme assigned to its spelling.
policy.approximation: Approximate use is scored separately and never changes the stored reading.

entries.note: Nombre un; context variants must stay explicit.

Context variants are not silently substituted.
